sql_in: WITH avg_loss AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(RFLD_EALT AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_ealt FROM nri WHERE GEOID LIKE '47%'), median_freq AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(RFLD_AFREQ, 0.5 ORDER BY RFLD_AFREQ) AS med_afreq FROM nri WHERE GEOID LIKE '22%') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.GEOID) AS num_high_risk_tracts FROM (SELECT DISTINCT GEOID FROM claims WHERE GEOID LIKE '22%') AS cl JOIN nri AS n ON cl.GEOID = n.GEOID JOIN cre AS cr ON cl.GEOID = cr.GEOID, avg_loss, median_freq WHERE n.RFLD_EALT > avg_loss.avg_ealt AND n.RFLD_AFREQ > median_freq.med_afreq
sql_out:
WITH avg_loss AS (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(RFLD_EALT AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_ealt 
    FROM nri 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '22%'
),
median_freq AS (
    SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(RFLD_AFREQ, 0.5) AS med_afreq 
    FROM nri 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '22%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.GEOID) AS num_high_risk_tracts
FROM claims AS cl
JOIN nri AS n ON cl.GEOID = n.GEOID
CROSS JOIN avg_loss
CROSS JOIN median_freq
WHERE cl.GEOID LIKE '22%'
  AND n.RFLD_EALT > avg_loss.avg_ealt
  AND n.RFLD_AFREQ > median_freq.med_afreq;

sql_in: WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG(RPL_THEMES) AS avg_svi FROM svi WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%'), med AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(CFLD_RISKS, 0.5 ORDER BY CFLD_RISKS) AS med_risk FROM nri WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%') SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT cl.GEOID) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GEOID) FROM claims WHERE STATEFP = '47') AS pct_qualified FROM (SELECT DISTINCT GEOID, STATEFP FROM claims WHERE STATEFP = '12') AS cl JOIN nri AS n ON cl.GEOID = n.GEOID JOIN svi AS s ON s.GEOID = cl.GEOID, stats, med WHERE n.CFLD_RISKS > med.med_risk AND s.RPL_THEMES < stats.avg_svi

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(RPL_THEMES) AS avg_svi 
    FROM svi 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%'
),
med AS (
    SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(CFLD_RISKS, 0.5) AS med_risk 
    FROM nri 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%'
),

),
qualified_tracts AS (

    FROM tract_claims tc
    JOIN nri n ON tc.GEOID = n.GEOID
    JOIN svi s ON tc.GEOID = s.GEOID
    CROSS JOIN stats
    CROSS JOIN med
    WHERE n.CFLD_RISKS > med.med_risk
      AND s.RPL_THEMES < stats.avg_svi
)

sql_out:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(RPL_THEMES) AS avg_svi 
    FROM svi 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%'
), 
med AS (
    SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(CFLD_RISKS, 0.5) AS med_risk 
    FROM nri 
    WHERE GEOID LIKE '12%'
)

FROM claims AS cl
JOIN nri AS n ON cl.GEOID = n.GEOID
JOIN svi AS s ON cl.GEOID = s.GEOID

sql_in: SELECT AVG(overlap_area) AS avg_overlap_area FROM (SELECT t.GEOID, SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12998' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) GROUP BY t.GEOID)
sql_out:
SELECT AVG(overlap_area) AS avg_overlap_area
FROM (
    SELECT t.GEOID, SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS overlap_area
    FROM census_tracts AS t
    JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry)
    WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12099'
      AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry)
      AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM census_tracts AS t2
          JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry)
          WHERE t2.GEOID = t.GEOID
            AND LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '12099'
            AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry)
            AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)
      )
    GROUP BY t.GEOID
);
